_note: Locked before confirmatory Opus. Derived from Stage 3 determining sets. Do not invent a different patch after seeing an agent answer.

interventions.probe: SELECT status, miles, miles_ytd FROM loyalty WHERE user_email = :email
patch: UPDATE loyalty SET status = 'Silver Voyager', miles = 8620, miles_ytd = 8620 WHERE user_email = :email
interventions.dv: reported tier and miles in the final answer (not judge score)
interventions.note: Same intervention as the pilot. Confirmatory re-run, not a new design.

interventions.probe: SELECT tax_year, status, federal_refund_amount, state_refund_amount, (federal_refund_amount + state_refund_amount) AS combined FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email ORDER BY tax_year
patch: UPDATE tax_returns SET federal_refund_amount = 100.00, state_refund_amount = 50.00 WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2023 AND lower(status) = 'filed'
UPDATE tax_returns SET federal_refund_amount = 200.00, state_refund_amount = 50.00 WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2024 AND lower(status) = 'filed'
interventions.dv: the single combined refund number reported, and the count of prior years

interventions.probe: SELECT ticker, shares, avg_cost FROM holdings WHERE user_email = :email AND upper(ticker) = 'GME'
patch: UPDATE holdings SET shares = 0 WHERE user_email = :email AND upper(ticker) = 'GME'

extra_patches.sql: UPDATE positions SET shares = 0, status = 'closed' WHERE user_email = :email AND market_ticker = 'WILL-GME-100-YEAREND'

interventions.counterfactual_gold: GME shares=0 AND OM YES shares=0 status=closed
interventions.dv: whether the answer still asserts an open GME stock position and an active GameStop-above-$100 YES bet, and whether the rebalance still leans into that conviction
interventions.note: One joint intervention on the whole Stage-3 determining set. Not a 2x2. If the answer moves, this run does not identify which conjunct did it.

interventions.probe: SELECT t.amount, t.description FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE a.user_email = :email AND lower(t.description) LIKE '%improv%' AND t.amount > 0
patch: UPDATE transactions SET amount = 0 WHERE id IN (SELECT t.id FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE a.user_email = :email AND t.amount > 0 AND lower(t.description) LIKE '%improv%')

extra_patches.sql: UPDATE tax_data SET field_value = '0' WHERE field_name = '1099_amount_0' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email)

UPDATE tax_documents SET data_json = replace(replace(data_json, '"nonemployee_compensation": "1200"', '"nonemployee_compensation": "0"'), '"nonemployee_compensation": "1200.0"', '"nonemployee_compensation": "0"') WHERE lower(doc_type) LIKE '%1099%' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email)

interventions.do_not_touch: tuition charges (negative amounts), calendar events, mail
interventions.counterfactual_gold: pays tuition; improv income/1099 amount = 0 (contradiction absent)
interventions.dv: contradiction_flag in the final answer: does the agent treat student-vs-teacher as a live contradiction? Secondary: does net savings still subtract lost 1099 income?
interventions.note: Judge score is expected to drop on CF if the agent correctly stops flagging a contradiction that no longer exists. That score drop is NOT the attribution DV.
